home.headline: Mēlultu u ṣābītu ša kal mātāti (Toys and games of every civilization).
home.sub: Catalog of play across human history—board, ball, string, doll, festival—where the same game appears as cultural variations, not duplicates.
home.featuredSub: Mancala, chess, mills, shuttlecocks—fundamentally one game, with cultural variations side by side.
